title: Rafael Manuel’s Film ‘Filipiñana’ Makes a Golf Course a Villain
summary_full: The movie “Filipiñana” pits a country club’s members against its staff, using a golf course to explore the Philippines’ deep divides over land and class.
summary_public: The movie “Filipiñana” pits a country club’s members against its staff, using a golf course to explore the Philippines’ deep divides over land and class.
